                                             ORDTXANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS3 Residendal Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11 -M in the area bounded by

      The alley next north of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; a line 41.54 feet east of and
      parallel to North Monitor Avenue; West Montrose Avenue; and North Monitor Avenue

to those of a RM4.5 Residenfial Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
